sections.title: Advanced Concept
sections.content: Level 3 involves complex 3D shapes, combinations, cones, pyramids, solids of revolution, and hollow sections. Includes multiple 3D shapes combined, holes, and practical applications.

sections.title: Complex Volume
sections.content: For a combined 3D shape: Total volume = Large volume - holes/cutouts + other combined volumes. Example: Hollow cylinder → V = πh(R²-r²)

sections.title: Cone and Pyramid
sections.content:
Cone volume = 1/3 × π × r² × h
Pyramid volume = 1/3 × base area × height
Surface area includes all triangular or curved surfaces.

sections.title: Solids of Revolution
sections.content: Rotating a shape around an axis forms a 3D object like Cylinder, Cone, Sphere. Use standard formulas.

sections.title: Similarity and Ratio
sections.content: For similar 3D shapes: Length ratio a:b → Area ratio a²:b² → Volume ratio a³:b³

sections.title: Real-Life Applications
sections.content: Used in tanks, silos, mixers, spherical containers, and construction involving composite or hollow volumes.

tricks.title: Hollow/Cutout Volume
tricks.explanation: Subtract smaller volume from the larger one.

tricks.title: Cone Volume Quick
tricks.explanation: Use 1/3 × π × r² × h. Multiply r² × h first then divide by 3.

tricks.title: Pyramid Volume
tricks.explanation: Base area × height ÷ 3 for mental estimation.

tricks.title: Surface Area of Revolved Shape
tricks.explanation: Cylinder → 2πrh + 2πr², Sphere → 4πr², Cone → πr(l+r) where l = slant height.

tricks.title: Ratio Based Quick Calculation
tricks.explanation: Length ratio a:b → area a²:b², volume a³:b³

tricks.title: Quick π Estimation
tricks.explanation: Use π≈3.14 for easy mental calculation.

tricks.title: Combined 3D Shape Volume
tricks.explanation: Compute volumes of all parts separately, then add or subtract as needed.
tricks.example: Cylinder + Cone r=3,h=10 → Cylinder=282.6, Cone=94.2 → Total ≈ 376.8

tricks.title: Hollow Shape
tricks.explanation: Net volume = Outer - Inner. For surface area, include only external surface.
tricks.example: Outer sphere r=7 → 1436, Inner r=5 → 523 → Net volume ≈ 913
